title: Rebind emitters and destroy planes
scope: Handle fluid/smoke endpoint replacement for emitters and destroy-plane resources.
acceptance: Create/update/remove and failed rebind preserve unrelated populations.
Repeated endpoint churn neither leaks memory nor targets an old generation.
